cause_quote: The new reader used a bare `catch {` to discard the load error and emitted the fixed message `Config unavailable; using environment and default agent directory settings.`
user_saw: Doctor warned that configuration was unavailable without explaining why it had rejected the existing file.
summary: The fix adds the original load error to the directory-resolution warning when an existing configuration file is rejected.
reasoning: First-parent history and the introducing diff show that PR #146092 added the directory-resolution reader with both the bare catch and the generic fallback warning. The fix PR's pre-fix Doctor run confirmed that this path omitted the schema-validation reason.
